banner.description: Whether to show the project banner (1) or not (0).

counter_pad.description: Minimum number of digits to be displayed for the hit count.

path_hits_file.description: Path to the hits control file. The directory must have R/W permission for the web server owner.

path_images.description: URL path to the digit images used for the counter display. Leave blank for text style.

visible.description: Whether the counter display is visible or invisible (counting only).

webcounter_id.description: Counter identifier, allows multiple counters to be used.
